description: An operating budget of an invented facilities department, built as an Excel workbook with openpyxl: 104 line items in 12 sections over three A4 portrait pages, the column header row set as print title row, amounts in the format #,##0;[Red](#,##0) (income in red brackets), a Change column computed by formula with red negative percentages, dates in d mmm yyyy, a header and a "Page X of Y" footer, fit to page width. Calibri is substituted by Carlito. LibreOffice Calc computed the formulas. The PDFs were rendered by LibreOffice 24.2 from the Office files (headless --convert-to pdf), not by Microsoft Office. Edits: the energy price inflation assumption lowered; the electricity budget lowered, which turns its Change from 4.9% into a red negative percentage; a new line 6219 for a lift modernisation study inserted after lift maintenance; the note of the guarding contract changed; the one-off line 7010 for office moves deleted; as a result the FY2027 total and its Change percentage changed. Account codes are fixed per line, so nothing renumbers. Consequences that are not listed: one row moves from page 1 to page 2 and one from page 2 to page 3, under the repeated column header row; the FY2025 and FY2026 totals do not change.

truth.note: Electricity Change, computed by formula; the sign changes and the cell turns red (number format [Red]), so a separate colour entry is legitimate.
